note: Operationalizes the F1 predictions (docs/findings/F1-canon-or-computation-note.md). Locking rule (inherited from the line): a changed prediction is a NEW version, never an edit. At v1 commit: the atlas kernel (Eightfold Phase K) + FOUNDRY_SPEC + a hand-checked toy stratum exist; NO generated census, NO oracle run, NO measured cell. The I-phase (I1-I6) and the Boolean census (N1) are not yet built.

P1_NPI_calibration.prediction: The census's decision=NPI-candidate row is EMPTY, by the Schaefer / Bulatov-Zhuk dichotomy (CSP(Gamma) is P or NP-complete, never NP-intermediate).
P1_NPI_calibration.decision_rule: FIRST analysis run = pipeline validation. If any census row carries decision=NPI-candidate, HALT: it is a pipeline bug (bad oracle / bad enumeration), not a discovery. Pass = zero NPI rows.

P2_gradient_persistence.prediction: The approximation<->parameterized gradient appears in tier-1 CSP-land with DIRECTION intact (harder-to-approximate co-occurs with harder-to-parameterize).
P2_gradient_persistence.decision_rule: Compute the both-real approx|parameterized Cramer's V on the census; SURVIVES iff it (a) beats the S1 null envelope (structure beyond typing) AND (b) is significant by permutation (p<0.05). RESIZE = the gradient does NOT persist -> the canon's-world finding (the gradient was roster sociology), acceptable and stated in advance.

P3_factor_reproduction.prediction: Canon-fitted latent-factor loadings (k=3-4 on file) reproduce on the census within a pre-stated tolerance.
P3_factor_reproduction.decision_rule: GATED ON FACTORS v1 EXISTING. Estimator: held-out-prediction (S1-disqualified MCA-style dimension counts). Registration via the canon-cap-census overlap anchors (3-SAT, 2-SAT, XOR-SAT, Horn-SAT, NAE-SAT, 1-in-3-SAT) BEFORE the loading comparison is read; controls validated by PROJECTION, never inclusion. If Factors v1 does not exist when Foundry runs, P3 is REPORTED UNTESTED, never approximated.
P3_factor_reproduction.status: UNTESTED at v1 (Factors v1 does not exist in the repo)

P4_tier2_inhabitation.prediction: At least one Eightfold A3 gap-list cell (post-Crucible resize) is inhabited by construction within the box.
P4_tier2_inhabitation.decision_rule: A construction attempt (padding / Ladner diagonalization / ensemble design) on the priority cell (average-case x landscape) either inhabits it (a `constructed` specimen, flagged, excluded from natural-population analyses) or produces a documented failed-attempt log. Pass = >=1 inhabited-or-logged.

roster_policy.boolean_tier: One Creignou-Kolaitis-Zanuttini plain-basis representative per Boolean co-clone off the known co-clone lattice (Rider B: generate at the co-clone level; enumeration of relation-sets is impossible at 2^256). Arity bound governs reachable co-clones; class sizes recorded. Hand-rolled enumeration is a small-arity cross-check only.
roster_policy.general_domain_tier: Domains 3-4, languages sampled uniform-random, deduped to polymorphism-equivalence where the oracle makes it checkable; one representative per realized class; class sizes recorded.
roster_policy.effective_n: Every analysis reports the distinct-charge-profile count alongside the row count; factor-power claims cite the former.

generations_policy.rule: Three independent generations of the sampled tier and of every measured ensemble. Between-generation variance is computed FIRST and is the noise floor all findings must exceed (glitch-check discipline). Self-averaging report: which statistics concentrate across generations, which don't (the latter is itself a finding).
generations_policy.note: The Boolean co-clone tier is DETERMINISTIC (canonical CKZ representatives) -> generations-exempt (a calibration property).

analysis_battery.engine: the Crucible-hardened battery, reused from eightfold via the Phase-K kernel with FOUNDRY_SPEC
analysis_battery.null_model: S1 (typing + per-charge marginals + entailment preserved; values shuffled by the swap-chain) run BEFORE any structure claim; the census must beat its own nulls.
analysis_battery.entailment_netting: R25 matrix-wide as STANDARD, not exception (net the theorem-forced component out of every association before calling it surprising).
analysis_battery.controls: the tractable co-clones = easy stratum; the affine (XOR) class = deceptive-terrain control (easy decision, hard measured landscape) — the model must place it distinctively (a pre-registered negative if it fails). Fit validated by PROJECTION, never inclusion.
analysis_battery.weightings: both reported — per-class (problem-space structure) and class-size-weighted (typical-random-problem structure).

kill_thresholds.K1_oracle_timebox: If the general-domain dichotomy oracle exceeds its I-phase-set timebox, scope collapses to the Boolean census; P1-P2 proceed; P3 reported untested.
kill_thresholds.K2_profile_poverty: If the Boolean tier realizes fewer distinct charge profiles than the I2-set floor, factor-question claims leave scope for this version; bias-verdict work continues.
kill_thresholds.K3_instrument_wallclock: Per-ensemble measurement exceeding 2x its estimate before first checkpoint is cut per the Proof-Census C3 precedent; coverage asymmetries documented, never silently dropped.
kill_thresholds.K4_timebox: 40 h paired across N0-N5; $50 CPU-only. N3-N5 individually deferrable without killing N1-N2's standalone value.
